cases.why: The page sets a '_ga' cookie at DOMContentLoaded (hasPreconsent = true) and its HTML contains no word matching BANNER_TEXT_PATTERN /cookie|consent|gdpr|privacy|accept|einwilligung/i (hasBannerText = false). Both conditions satisfied: perDocument emits 'privacy:no-banner-with-cookies' at document scope. evaluate() produces ruleId 'privacy-no-banner' with severity 'serious'. GDPR Art. 7 requires that consent be demonstrably obtained before placing non-essential cookies; no banner means consent was never sought.
